reason: The free app already does the thing I need, which is getting me to start. Pet species, a decorated room and app icons are fluff, and I don't pay for fluff.
objection: Nothing here saves me time. Widgets and the Dynamic Island timer are the only useful parts, and I'm not paying $6.99 for that when I already don't use my other to-do apps.
would_change_my_mind: If the routine packs and the Dynamic Island timer were sold on their own for about $2-3 and clearly helped me start tasks faster.
